paite: "Bang achia namte heh a, bang achia michih in thil phatuam lou ngaihtuah uh ahia?
heading: Pathian Tel Kumpipa
english: Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?

paite: Leitung a kumpipate akisa duamduam ua, heutute'n leng TOUPA leh athaunilh kalh asawm chiat uh,
english: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take counsel together, against Yahweh, and against his Anointed, saying,

paite: agaknate uh hihtat in, akhauhualte uh ei a kipan i paimang ding uh," chi in.
english: “Let’s break their bonds apart, and cast their cords from us.”

paite: "Van a tupa anui dia; TOUPA'N amaute anuihsan ding hi.
english: He who sits in the heavens will laugh. The Lord will have them in derision.

paite: Huai khit chiang in heh in akiang uah thu agen ding a, thangpaitak in amaute ahihmangbangta ding hi.
english: Then he will speak to them in his anger, and terrify them in his wrath:

paite: Kei mahmah in ka mual siangthou Zion ah ka kumpipa ka tusak hi," achi hi.
english: “Yet I have set my King on my holy hill of Zion.”

paite: Thusehsa ka gen ding hi; TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Nang zaw ka tapa na hi a; tuni in ka hon neikhia ahi.
english: I will tell of the decree: Yahweh said to me, “You are my son. Today I have become your father.

paite: Hon ngen in, huchi in na gouluah ding in namte ka hon pe dia, kawlmong tawp tan in na gou ding in leng ka hon pe ding hi.
english: Ask of me, and I will give the nations for your inheritance, the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession.

paite: Sikchiang in amaute na hihkham dia; belvelmi'n bel apaihkhap bang un na paikham ding,” achi hi.
english: You shall break them with a rod of iron. You shall dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.”

paite: Huchi in kumpipate aw, pilta unla; leitung a vaihawmte aw, thuzoh in omta un.
english: Now therefore be wise, you kings. Be instructed, you judges of the earth.

paite: Laudan siam in TOUPA nna sem unla, ling kawm in kipak un.
english: Serve Yahweh with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

paite: Tapa tawp unla, huchi keileh aheh ding a, lam lak ah na mangthang kha ding uh, athangpai zok ding hi. Amah a ginna koih tengteng ahampha uhi.
english: Give sincere homage to the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish on the way, for his wrath will soon be kindled. Blessed are all those who take refuge in him.
